title: 90-Degree Clamp Angle – Drilling Guide
author: KoliBrix
description:
A perfect 90° helper for your workshop! This printable angle can be fixed with clamps and assists with drilling, gluing, or aligning boards. Simple to print, robust, and indispensable for precise work.

Always open to further versions, critique, and suggestions for improvement! :)

Boost Me (for free)

This model has had a few hours of design, testing, fine-tuning, and attention to detail. If this model has landed on your print bed, a boost is of course not mandatory, but a strong sign! It supports and motivates the continued transformation of crazy ideas into matter and not letting them disappear in CAD…. Thank you for your support 💙
